summary:
MailDev 3.0 is a web interface for an SMTP test server. It shows an email list on the left and an email viewer on the right, and it was seeded with about 260 emails from the fictional 'Fernhill' app. I saved 4 views:
1. email-html-view: the inbox list with an appointment reminder open, showing the header, the .ics attachment chip, the HTML/Plain Text/Headers/Source tabs and the rendered HTML preview.
2. email-source: the same email on the Source tab, showing the raw MIME message in monospace.
3. command-palette: the Ctrl+K palette over the blurred inbox, with email actions, navigation commands and shortcut hints.
4. search-relay-menu: the list filtered by the search "maintenance", with an email to 5 recipients (plus CC and BCC) open and the Relay dropdown expanded (relay to original recipients or to a custom address).
Two more views were rejected by the harness as near-duplicates: the email preview at the 375px viewport size (too close to view 1) and the small Settings popover with notification toggles (too close to view 3). I didn't save the Headers tab because it only shows three rows, and I left out the dark theme on purpose. Email routes look like /#/email/:id, but every view gets there by clicking from / so replays work the same way each time.
